moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially started today, August 21st, with reigning champions Arsenal hosting Coventry City, and a packed weekend of fixtures ahead.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / Heavy Sports

angles.name: Opening Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's BACK! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicked off today with Arsenal taking on Coventry City. Who are you backing this weekend?

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: Football fans, your weekend is sorted! Man Utd, Liverpool, Chelsea and more are all in action. Get the full fixture list and make your predictions.

moments.title: Happy 31st, Dua Lipa!
moments.blurb: British superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday tomorrow, August 22nd. The Grammy-winner is known for hits like 'New Rules' and 'Levitating'.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-Out
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the incredible Dua Lipa turns 31! What's your favourite track from the London-born pop sensation?

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: From 'New Rules' to 'Levitating', Dua Lipa has given us so many bops. Wishing her a very happy 31st birthday for tomorrow!

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Latest
moments.blurb: The latest Official Singles Chart for August 20-26, 2026, is out now, with Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continuing its record-breaking run at number one.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at number one! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is dominating the Official Singles Chart. Is it still on your playlist?

angles.name: Chart Records
angles.copy: History in the making! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean is now the longest-running UK number one single ever. Incredible stuff!

moments.title: Shania Twain Turns 61
moments.blurb: Country-pop icon Shania Twain will celebrate her 61st birthday on August 28th. The 'Queen of Country Pop' has sold over 100 million records worldwide.

angles.name: Ahead of the Birthday
angles.copy: Next Friday, August 28th, we're celebrating the one and only Shania Twain as she turns 61! What's your ultimate Shania anthem?

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop
angles.copy: Man! She feels like a woman! Shania Twain celebrates her 61st next week. Get ready for some classic country-pop.

moments.title: Florence Welch Turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the captivating frontwoman of Florence + The Machine, will celebrate her 40th birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Next Friday, August 28th, we wish a very happy 40th birthday to the incredible Florence Welch! What's your favourite Florence + The Machine track?

angles.name: Celebrating Florence
angles.copy: Turning 40 next week, Florence Welch continues to inspire with her powerful vocals and unique style. Which Florence + The Machine song defines her for you?

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival Approaches
moments.blurb: London is gearing up for the iconic Notting Hill Carnival, taking place over the August Bank Holiday weekend, from August 30th to 31st, with Panorama on the 29th.

source.l: Notting Hill Carnival Official / Westminster City Council

angles.name: Carnival Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Notting Hill Carnival! Kicking off next Friday with Panorama, then the main event over the bank holiday weekend. Are you ready?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Vibes
angles.copy: August Bank Holiday weekend means one thing in London: Notting Hill Carnival! Get ready for the vibrant celebrations, music and incredible atmosphere.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The last bank holiday of the summer for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking a long weekend for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: That long weekend feeling is just around the corner! The August Bank Holiday is Monday 31st. What are your plans for the extra day off?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: It's the last Bank Holiday of the summer for most of the UK next Monday. Let's make it count!

moments.title: Special Olympics National Summer Games
moments.blurb: The Special Olympics National Summer Games 2026 are taking place in Birmingham from August 27th to 30th, featuring multiple sports at Alexander Stadium and Wyndley Leisure Centre.

angles.name: Celebrating Athletes
angles.copy: Next week, Birmingham hosts the Special Olympics National Summer Games! Wishing all the incredible athletes the very best.

angles.name: Birmingham Hosts
angles.copy: The Special Olympics National Summer Games are coming to Birmingham from August 27-30. A fantastic showcase of talent and spirit!

moments.title: The Chelsea Detective Returns
moments.blurb: Series 2 of the popular crime drama 'The Chelsea Detective' is set to premiere in the UK on U&Alibi this August, following a special preview screening on August 18th.

angles.name: New Season Alert
angles.copy: Detective fans, rejoice! The Chelsea Detective is back for its second series on U&Alibi this August. Who's tuning in?

angles.name: Crime Drama Fix
angles.copy: Need a new crime drama fix? The Chelsea Detective Season 2 has arrived! Get ready to solve some mysteries.
